implemented.item: Scoped Codex business tool and capability gate
implemented.behavior: Only role tool_ids plus the frozen ready video capability admit generated_video_create. Preparation validates the exact spec and stores a persistent operation through prepare_ai_video_job before HTTP. Public readiness depends on a current ready, unrevoked, published or verified capability matching the gateway fingerprint.

implemented.item: Persistent asynchronous submit, lookup, polling and cancellation
implemented.behavior: Lease-fenced worker steps claim one existing job, submit once, and recover lost submissions by the original operation rather than a fresh POST. Cancellation is an observed provider fact, not merely a locally changed state; signed callbacks reject conflicting identities and stale/regressive observations.

implemented.item: Known/unknown costs and immutable settlement evidence
implemented.behavior: Billable seconds and frozen integer rate determine stored actual cost. Unknown dispatched operations preserve uncertainty/reservation; only an undispatched intent is locally provable zero. Budget overages are retained and block delivery. The common task budget/receipt projection includes known video charges or unknown quotes.

implemented.item: Actual binary validation, references and immutable authorized delivery
implemented.behavior: Reference input is a bounded, decoded PNG/JPEG version (maximum 10 MB). Output requires exact SHA-256/bytes, MP4 H.264, fixed duration/resolution, optional AAC, frame count and actual FFmpeg full decode before saveAsset creates an immutable version. State='completed' alone is insufficient. Current protocol supports 720x1280, 1280x720 and 1024x1024, with 4/8/12/16/20 seconds and a 100 MB content bound.

implemented.item: Customer read/cancel/preview and independent administrator cost recheck
implemented.behavior: Authenticated customer routes enforce project/private scope and revisions; callbacks use a timestamped HMAC. Admin request and cost permissions are separate and return metadata/cost, not prompt/reference/media. Recheck observes the original operation and explicitly does not submit a new generation. Inline preview is limited to 20 MB; larger valid video needs download.
